capabilities.description: Risk scan of an SPL token mint (authorities, metadata, liquidity)
Read-only DEX market data (liquidity, FDV, buy/sell pressure)

description: Solana token risk-sentry: read-only rug-risk scanner. Given any SPL mint, SENTINEL inspects on-chain authorities (mint/freeze), Metaplex metadata, and live DEX liquidity, then returns a 0-100 risk score with a plain-English verdict. Strictly read-only — it never signs, never moves funds; a Bento-style policy engine blocks all value-moving actions by default.

metadata.policy: deny-by-default for value movement; read-only actions auto-allowed; full audit log

name: SENTINEL
